summary: Tested the branch store page Kategori row and the Sidoarjo store page scoping. Backend: new tests/test_iter66_store_categories.py passed 9/9, and the test_iter64_shop_scope.py regression passed 14/14 (its Sidoarjo assertions still hold). Run both with -n 0 (pytest.ini enables xdist). GET /api/stores/{id}/categories for jombang, jember and official returns only main categories with count>0, sorted by count descending. It returns 404 for a marketplace store and for an unknown store. Each count equals the number of products in /products?category&branch with X-Shop-Page (for example perlengkapan-bayi = 11). The hide test renamed price to _bak_price on the Jombang store_stock rows of all 11 perlengkapan-bayi products. The category then disappeared for Jombang only, while the Jember and Sidoarjo counts were unchanged. The Jombang store page showed 13 categories and '6607 produk toko', Jember showed 14, and the Beranda list was unaffected. Everything was restored: 0 _bak_price rows, 6618 priced in Jombang. For Sidoarjo, temporary TEST_ products were inserted: a marketplace seller product and a pgs-official product with price 0. Both were excluded from the shop scope (X-Shop-Page + X-Store-Id pgs-official). The marketplace product was still visible without the header. Both were deleted by id afterwards. Frontend at 375x667: the /shop/pgs-jombang category row is loaded from /stores/pgs-jombang/categories (14 items, sorted). Tapping Perlengkapan Bayi opens /category/perlengkapan-bayi?toko=pgs-jombang with the header 'di Mitra PGS Jombang' and 11 Jombang-labelled cards, and the request carried X-Shop-Page:1. The Beranda category tap opens /category/perlengkapan-bayi with no header and no X-Shop-Page, and the cards show 'PGS · semua cabang'. The /shop/pgs-official popular, newest and recommend rails show 'PGS Sidoarjo' and Sidoarjo's own stock, with 0 'semua cabang' labels, and the page shows '6618 produk toko'. Beranda shows 'Cari dari 6.618 produk'.

issues: 'Lihat Semua' still pushes /kategori without branch scope. From there, categories open the unfiltered /category/{id}, and empty categories for the branch are listed. This is inconsistent with the scoped icon row (home-feed.tsx:73).

action_items: Optional: when shop=true, make the Kategori 'Lihat Semua' link branch-aware (e.g. /kategori?toko=<branch>, or hide the link).
critical_code_review_comments: store_page.store_categories scans every visible product on each request (0.12–0.23s now with 6.6k products). Consider an aggregation pipeline or a short cache if the catalog grows.

Of the 6618 products, 215 have no categories and are counted under 'lainnya'. There is no 'lainnya' main category doc, so they never appear in the store category row. Beranda has the same behavior, so this is consistent but these products cannot be reached from the icons.

HomeFeedSections calls api.shopCategories(storeId) with the context branch, not the route's store id. This is correct only because the store page switches the stored branch to the page branch (verified in iterations 65 and 66).
seed_data_creation: None persisted. The Jombang store_stock price was temporarily renamed to _bak_price for the 11 perlengkapan-bayi products and restored (0 _bak_price rows, 6618 Jombang priced). 2 TEST_ products were inserted by the test fixture and deleted by id (0 TEST_ products remain, total 6618).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run the pytest files with -n 0 (pytest.ini adds xdist). /tmp/hidecat.py hide|restore toggles the Jombang prices of perlengkapan-bayi. The frontend URL is in EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL in frontend/.env. To pass the location gate, use context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) and set_geolocation, then click location-allow.
